<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000"/>
      <stop offset=".52" stop-color="#1E1E1E"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#363636"/>
      <animate attributeName="x1" values="0;1;0" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ring" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#4285F4"/>
      <stop offset=".28" stop-color="#EA4437"/>
      <stop offset=".55" stop-color="#FBBE0D"/>
      <stop offset=".8" stop-color="#379D53"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#4285F4"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="glow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="9"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2"/>
    </filter>
    <clipPath id="screen">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" rx="35"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <g clip-path="url(#screen)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity=".28">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values=".72;.2;.42;.72" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>

    <g opacity=".18" filter="url(#glow)">
      <rect x="28" y="112" width="68" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4285F4"/>
      <rect x="294" y="167" width="70" height="4" rx="2" fill="#EA4437"/>
      <rect x="22" y="591" width="80" height="4" rx="2" fill="#379D53"/>
      <rect x="284" y="674" width="82" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FBBE0D"/>
    </g>

    <!-- sequential orbiting geometric assembly -->
    <g transform="translate(195 402)">
      <g opacity=".18" filter="url(#glow)">
        <rect x="-90" y="-90" width="180" height="180" rx="90" fill="none" stroke="url(#ring)" stroke-width="18">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
      </g>
      <g>
        <rect x="-8" y="-153" width="16" height="55" rx="8" fill="#4285F4">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="-8" y="98" width="16" height="55" rx="8" fill="#FBBE0D">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="-360" dur="4.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="-153" y="-8" width="55" height="16" rx="8" fill="#379D53">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="5.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="98" y="-8" width="55" height="16" rx="8" fill="#EA4437">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="-360" dur="4.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="-49" y="-122" width="16" height="48" rx="8" fill="#EA4437" transform="rotate(-45)">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="-45" to="315" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="33" y="-122" width="16" height="48" rx="8" fill="#379D53" transform="rotate(45)">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="45" to="405" dur="5.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="-49" y="74" width="16" height="48" rx="8" fill="#4285F4" transform="rotate(45)">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="45" to="405" dur="5.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="33" y="74" width="16" height="48" rx="8" fill="#FBBE0D" transform="rotate(-45)">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="-45" to="315" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
      </g>

      <g transform="rotate(45)">
        <rect x="-55" y="-55" width="110" height="110" rx="27" fill="#1E1E1E" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3">
          <animate attributeName="rx" values="27;55;27" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="-38" y="-38" width="76" height="76" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".96">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="-90" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </rect>
        <rect x="-23" y="-23" width="46" height="46" rx="10" fill="#1E1E1E"/>
        <rect x="-7" y="-42" width="14" height="84" rx="7" fill="#4285F4"/>
        <rect x="-42" y="-7" width="84" height="14" rx="7" fill="#EA4437"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- particles, sequentially appearing -->
    <g>
      <rect x="44" y="213" width="5" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#4285F4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.6s" begin=".2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
      <rect x="68" y="267" width="8" height="8" rx="4" fill="#EA4437"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.6s" begin=".5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
      <rect x="107" y="177" width="6" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FBBE0D"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.6s" begin=".8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
      <rect x="282" y="220" width="7" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#379D53"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.6s" begin="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
      <rect x="326" y="288" width="5" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#4285F4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.6s" begin="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
      <rect x="48" y="475" width="7" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#FBBE0D"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.6s" begin="1.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
      <rect x="92" y="536" width="5" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#379D53"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.6s" begin="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
      <rect x="305" y="507" width="8" height="8" rx="4" fill="#EA4437"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.6s" begin="2.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
      <rect x="346" y="438" width="6" height="6" rx="3" fill="#4285F4"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.6s" begin="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
      <rect x="267" y="573" width="5" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#FBBE0D"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2.6s" begin="2.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></rect>
    </g>

    <!-- bottom transition surface -->
    <rect x="20" y="680" width="350" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".12"/>
    <rect x="30" y="704" width="330" height="52" rx="26" fill="#2B2B2B" stroke="#363636" stroke-width="1.5">
      <animate attributeName="y" values="780;704;704" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
    <rect x="47" y="721" width="8" height="8" rx="4" fill="#4285F4"/>
    <rect x="61" y="721" width="8" height="8" rx="4" fill="#EA4437"/>
    <rect x="75" y="721" width="8" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FBBE0D"/>
    <rect x="89" y="721" width="8" height="8" rx="4" fill="#379D53"/>
    <rect x="111" y="718" width="170" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".16"/>
    <rect x="111" y="718" width="112" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="url(#ring)">
      <animate attributeName="width" values="20;170;20" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
    <rect x="304" y="713" width="32" height="32" rx="16" fill="#363636" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".16"/>
    <rect x="317" y="721" width="6" height="15" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".7"/>
    <rect x="312" y="726" width="16" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".7"/>

    <!-- status bar -->
    <text x="22" y="28" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <g fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="326" y="21" width="3" height="7" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="331" y="18" width="3" height="10" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="336" y="15" width="3" height="13" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="341" y="12" width="3" height="16" rx="1"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5">
      <circle cx="357" cy="22" r="4"/>
      <line x1="350" y1="28" x2="364" y2="28"/>
    </g>
    <rect x="369" y="16" width="18" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="18" width="13" height="8" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="388" y="20" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- navigation bar -->
    <rect x="0" y="790" width="390" height="54" fill="#000000" opacity=".38"/>
    <g stroke="#A0A0A0" stroke-width="2" fill="none">
      <polygon points="45,813 54,805 63,813" fill="none"/>
      <rect x="48" y="812" width="12" height="10" rx="2"/>
      <circle cx="129" cy="812" r="7"/>
      <line x1="134" y1="817" x2="140" y2="823"/>
      <rect x="193" y="805" width="18" height="14" rx="4"/>
      <polygon points="197,819 201,824 204,819" fill="#1E1E1E"/>
      <circle cx="274" cy="811" r="8"/>
      <line x1="269" y1="811" x2="279" y2="811"/>
      <line x1="274" y1="806" x2="274" y2="816"/>
      <rect x="333" y="804" width="17" height="17" rx="8.5"/>
      <circle cx="341.5" cy="809" r="3"/>
    </g>
    <text x="54" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Главная</text>
    <text x="130" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#A0A0A0">Поиск</text>
    <text x="202" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#A0A0A0">Алиса</text>
    <text x="274" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#A0A0A0">Создать</text>
    <text x="342" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#A0A0A0">Профиль</text>
  </g>
</svg>
